description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/current_job_listing.txt and correctly identify this as an experienced technical buyer (47 hires, $180k+ spent, explicit 'we know our stack' language) requiring the 'Be concise, lead with results' strategy. (2) Generate a proposal that NEVER starts with 'I' and contains none of the six banned template phrases. (3) Structure the proposal with all five required sections: opening hook referencing a specific job detail (Salesforce/Stripe/PostgreSQL/Tableau), problem restatement, bullet-pointed approach steps, quantified experience, and CTA. (4) Keep the proposal body within 150-500 words. (5) Include a Pricing section with a specific dollar rate for data analysis work (market rate: $60-120/hr mid-level), a one-sentence justification, and a phased/milestone alternative. (6) Add Upwork platform-specific tip (keep under 300 words). (7) Include 2-3 clarifying questions demonstrating domain expertise. (8) Include a follow-up message template for 48hrs after no response. Save all of this as upwork_bid_package.md in the workspace.
